description: This file defines the CellDataValidation class responsible for mapping DataValidation properties to their respective internal representations for XLS writing within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: CellDataValidation
classes.description: Provides static methods to convert DataValidation object properties into internal XLS representations for the PhpSpreadsheet library.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the internal type code for the given DataValidation object based on its type property.

methods.name: errorStyle
methods.description: Returns the internal error style code for the given DataValidation object.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Returns the internal operator code for the given DataValidation object.
